event_page.description: Event page title, prefixed with the localized namespace. If the page is on a different wiki, the namespace is formatted in that wiki's language.

event_page_wiki.description: Wiki ID of the event page.

status.description:
Event status:
* `open` - Registration is accepting participants
* `closed` - Registration is closed to participants

timezone.description: Timezone identifier, in any format accepted by PHP's DateTimeZone

start_time.description: Event start time in MediaWiki timestamp format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), local to the event timezone.

end_time.description: Event end time in MediaWiki timestamp format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), local to the event timezone.

wikis.description: Associated wiki IDs. `["*"]` means all wikis.

online_meeting.description: Whether the event has an online meeting component

inperson_meeting.description: Whether the event has an in-person meeting component

meeting_url.description: URL for the online meeting. Null if not set. Absent from the response if not visible to the requester.

meeting_country_code.description: CLDR country code for in-person location

chat_url.description: URL of the event chat channel. Null if not set. Absent from the response if not visible to the requester.

is_test_event.description: Whether the event is a test event excluded from statistics

tracks_contributions.description: Whether the event tracks wiki contributions

tracking_tools.description: External tracking tools associated with the event

tool_event_id.description: Event's identifier within the tracking tool

questions.description: Participant question IDs enabled for the event
